title: Canonical acyclic Cech edges commute with additive maps, site change, and forgetting module structure
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be small sites with final objects and abelian sheaf cohomology [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let $\mathcal U=(U_i\to1_{\mathcal C})$ be a finite covering, $A$ an abelian sheaf, and assume $H^r(U_{i_0}\times\cdots\times U_{i_t},A)=0$ for every $r>0$ and every nonempty tuple. The canonical edge map $e_{\mathcal U,A}^q:\check H^q(\mathcal U,A)\to H^q(\mathcal C,A)$ [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex] is an isomorphism for $q\ge0$. Its normalization is $H^q(\alpha)^{-1}H^q(\beta)$, where, for an injective resolution $A\to I^\bullet$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions], $\alpha$ is restriction from $\Gamma(I^\bullet)$ to $\operatorname{Tot}(\check C^\bullet(\mathcal U,I^\bullet))$, with total differential $d_C+(-1)^t d_I$ in Cech degree $t$ [def-sp-double-complex-total] and $\beta$ is induced by the resolution augmentation. These maps are independent of the resolution and natural for every morphism of abelian sheaves between objects satisfying the stated acyclicity, without any linearity assumption.
Let $f:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ be a morphism of sites presented by a continuous functor $u:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ preserving the final object and the tuple fibre products of $\mathcal U$, and carrying $\mathcal U$ to a covering $u\mathcal U$. Let $B$ be an abelian sheaf on $\mathcal D$, acyclic on every tuple intersection of $u\mathcal U$, and let $h:A\to f_*B$ be an additive sheaf map. Its section components define $h_C:\check C(\mathcal U,A)\to\check C(u\mathcal U,B)$. If $h_H:H^q(\mathcal C,A)\to H^q(\mathcal D,B)$ is the canonical cohomology map of $h$ (equivalently, inverse-image pullback followed by the adjoint $f^{-1}A\to B$), then $h_H e_{\mathcal U,A}^q=e_{u\mathcal U,B}^q H^q(h_C)$.
Finally, module cohomology means the right derived functors of evaluation in sheaves of modules, computed by injective resolutions [def-sp-left-exact-additive, def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Let $\mathcal O$ be a sheaf of rings on $\mathcal C$, and $M$ a sheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] acyclic on the tuple intersections in both module and underlying abelian cohomology. After identifying the underlying section Cech complexes, its canonical module Cech edge followed by the canonical module-to-abelian cohomology identification equals $e_{\mathcal U,M_{ab}}^q$. Here $M_{ab}$ is $M$ with scalar multiplication forgotten; the canonical identification is the unique morphism of universal $\delta$-functors inducing the identity on degree-zero sections [lem-weil-pbc-right-derived-universal-delta-functor].
